answer: Every new agent posts a 2,000 POA stake bond plus an opal-tier credential locked to a hardware key. Three already-bonded agents co-sign the entry, and escrow freezes 400 POA of each sponsor's bond. Sponsors also clear a quarterly live check, which caps onboarding at 200 agents a day per cluster. If the newcomer turns out to run 50 sock puppets, every co-signer is slashed 40% in one block. To forge 10,000 fake identities would burn near $480,000 in collateral and 30 days of review. Picture a walnut with a chain bored through it. Easy to pick up, impossible to hide a second nut inside.
